why: This is a review-based theoretical controversy about the effects of form-focused instruction, not a general learning theory or a distinct theory beyond the empirical claim it summarizes.
The Five Facet Mindfulness Questionnaire is a named self-report measurement instrument, not a general instructional element.
name: Five Facet Mindfulness Questionnaire (FFMQ)
product_description: A 39-item self-report assessment developed by Baer and colleagues that measures five facets of dispositional mindfulness, including observing, describing, acting with awareness, nonjudging, and nonreactivity.
